messages:
amit: FYI, canary GPU cluster got the CUDA/drivers bump last night. We're seeing unexpected kernel selection variance that looks tied to sequence-length heuristics.
maria: saw this on perf dash, seq=256/512 produce different kernel paths on A100 vs H100 after upgrade. tail latency +15-30% on some p50->p95 slices.
ben: deploy-bot shows the driver change completed at 03:12 UTC. infra-bot: Driver upgrade completed on canary nodes (staging-gpu-*) :white_check_mark:.
kai: quick probe: nvprof / nsight sampling shows time spent in "attention_kernel_v2" jumped ~22% for seq=512 on one model variant. seq=128 unchanged.
amit: here's a short trace snippet from the runtime profiler: ```trace: model=redwood-tiny, seq=512, kernel=attention_kernel_v2, time_ms=1.22 -> 1.48 (+21%)
kv_cache_hit_rate=0.87, batch_size=8, kv_round_trips=3```
maria: interesting — autotuner should have selected attention_kernel_v1 for that architecture historically. autotune logs show a different ranking post-upgrade: `score(attn_v2)>score(attn_v1)` for H100.
eva: can we reproduce locally with CUDA env flags? maybe a heuristic threshold shifted with new cuBLAS primitives.
ben: tried reproducing on my local H100 node with the same image. running `REDWOOD_AUTOTUNE_DEBUG=1 ./bin/serve --model redwood-tiny --seq 512` gives consistent pick of v2 and slightly worse perf vs pinned v1.
kai: quick test: forcing old pick via env `REDWOOD_KERNEL_HINT=attn_v1` drops latency back ~18% p95. Not ideal long-term but useful for mitigation.
amit: good. let's use that as a short-lived mitigation on affected canary shards. I'll open rollout to set hint for model: redwood-tiny, route=canary.
sre-oncall: if we flip kernel hints at scale we should watch memory patterns — KV cache alignment differs between v1/v2. add watch for OOMs.
maria: added a metric alert for increased KV cache miss penalty and memory high-water mark on canary.
eva: suggestion for root cause: kernel autotuner uses a micro-benchmark that depends on `warp_reduction` throughput. Driver update altered scheduling so the micro-benchmark overweights a path that is slower in full runtime.
ben: agree. plan: 1) apply kernel hint on canary shards (mitigation) 2) collect end-to-end traces for seq=128/256/512 3) run autotune with expanded workload sims (include kv cache warmups and batching distribution) 4) consider rolling back driver if user impact grows.
amit: opened a short ticket with perf artifacts and attached profiler snapshots: https://internal.redwood/perf/1729801234 — please drop any logs there.
kai: one more note — the runtime has a fallback policy `kernel_fallback=true` that can auto-switch to v1 on >10% regression per minute. It was disabled for canary to avoid noisy switches; maybe re-enable for now.
sre-oncall: re-enable fallback but cap frequency to avoid oscillation. I'll update the SLO runbook.
maria: I'll run an extended autotune job against the new driver on an isolated rig with synthetic kv patterns and variable batching, will post results in thread when done.
eva: long term: we should make autotuner include full-stack microbenchmarks (KV cache warmups, batching mix) and add driver-version as a dimension to artifacts so kernel picks are versioned.
amit: agreed. short-term action items: apply `REDWOOD_KERNEL_HINT=attn_v1` to canary for affected models, re-enable bounded fallback, run expanded autotune, hold on driver stage to prod until metrics stable.
ben: applying hint now to 4 canary shards :zap:. will flag if any OOMs.
amaria: thanks — will monitor the perf dash and post p50/p95 deltas. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Config update pushed to canary: set REDWOOD_KERNEL_HINT=attn_v1 for route redwood-tiny-canary.
amit: keeping this thread as the canonical log. please add short notes to the incident tracker if you dig anything else.
eva: I'll follow up with a PR to autotune harness to include kv warmups and sequence-length distribution fixtures.
ben: ETA on rollback decision if we see worsening production impact? I'd say 2 hours of sustained >10% p95 regressions triggers rollback.
sre-oncall: acknowledged. alert thresholds and rollback playbook updated.
maria: posting a short summary and next-check time in 30m.
amit: thanks team.
